Interface Lifecycle

public interface Lifecycle
Requests the shutdown of the application. A singleton.

A request may be made from any thread. It hands the shutdown to the UiExecutor: with the UI module, it returns at once and the shutdown runs on the EDT; with core's default, the shutdown runs on the calling thread before it returns. A request made while a shutdown runs is ignored.

The shutdown asks every ExitVeto, from the innermost scope to the outermost, and stops at the first one that returns false. Otherwise it cancels the running tasks and waits for them, runs every ShutdownStep, closes the root injector and calls Exit.exit(int).
